intro: Heralath Fallowbrook is a dying night elf druid imprisoned deep within Razorfen Kraul. Dispatched to investigate the thorny corruption surrounding the remains of the Ancient Agamaggan, he was captured and brutalized by the Razorfen tribe. With his final breaths, he seeks to send word of his fate and a cherished pendant back to his wife in Darnassus.

p: Sent by his people to investigate the ancient boar god Agamaggan and the spreading briars choking the southern Barrens, Heralath Fallowbrook sought the root of Razorfen Kraul's corruption. Instead of unearthing answers, the night elf was taken prisoner by the quilboar. Locked in a squalid pen and relentlessly beaten, Heralath succumbed to severe wounds and raging fever. Before fading entirely, he shared what he knew with a fellow captive, the dwarf Henrig Lonebrow, urging him to warn the sentinel outpost at Thalanaar about the aggression stirred up by the quilboar crone Charlga Razorflank.
